name: Assistance to OBM Boat Owner Fishermen on Purchase of Kerosene/Petrol
benefit: **Assistance under the scheme:** **Name of Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Assistance on the purchase of Kerosene/Petrol Maximum assistance of ₹50/- per literBenefits are available as per the prescribed quota throughout the year.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a fisherman. 1. The applicant must be a Kerosene Card holder. 1. The applicant must own a small boat operated by an Outboard Motor (OBM).
